claim.value: Fourteen of the 90 sampled orders lack approval attachments in the purchasing system.
claim.scope: The sampled orders and purchasing-system attachments only; no conclusion about whether approval occurred.

provenance.rationale: P003 supplies the count, sample size, record location and distinction between missing attachments and absent approval.

signal_basis.value: The mapping identifies the absence of purchasing-system approval attachments for 14 of 90 sampled orders as an established observation.
signal_basis.scope: Attachment presence in the purchasing system for the sampled orders.

provenance.rationale: P003 explicitly identifies this record-level observation as established.
The claim directly reports the established observation; no unresolved empirical relation is needed.

rationale: The claim stays within the observed attachment status and sample counts explicitly established by the mapping. It does not infer absent approval or a population failure rate.
